messages.subject: strand option for getAssociationWithTSS(x)
parts:
Dear group,

 

I see in that the “getAssociationWithTSS(x)” does not have a strand option.

 

I understand this to mean that the nearest TSS is assigned to the CG is the closest no matter which strand the TSS is annotated to in my gene.obj file.

 

I want to have my strand-specific data matched to strand-specific nearest TSS.  Is there a way to do this, especially since throughout the whole process, I have been keeping the CG strand information and data separate at the previous function “annotate.WithGenicParts”

 

Michelle

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] strand option for getAssociationWithTSS(x)
parts:
getAssociationWithTSS(x) is just an accessor for for the result of annotate.WithGenicParts(), which has a strand option. I think if you set strand=TRUE in annotate.WithGenicParts(), getAssociationWithTSS(x) will have the associations done in a stranded manner

Best,
Altuna
